|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Lando's Luxury Yacht. The image is the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Lady_Luck.png]]), which prints it. The later version [[Lady Luck]] (PC-E1, the current card) has the same game text under the title •Lady Luck.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed as “•Lando's Luxury Yacht” on the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012), p. 4<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, and listed under that title, with the same text, on the PC website card list from 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-old-lady">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual Block 8.2 cards are not in the archived Virtual Master list captures (the Virtual Block 8.2 cards first appear in the capture of 12 December 2012)</ref>: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Scoundrels deploy -1 aboard. May reveal from hand to ▲ [Cloud City] Lando and deploy both simultaneously. While Lando piloting, immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if at Bespin).” The card list spells out the ▲ (“take into hand … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle;”), icon notation only.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lady Luck]]): the title changed to “•Lady Luck”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-lady">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, PDF page 50)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Lady Luck. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-27-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-ladyluck-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
